mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates below 0.5% compress equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic overheating and impending policy tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods despite rising INDPRO, or Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate rising above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) signals rising wage pressures and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS growth and low UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annually), rising consumer prices erode real corporate profits and prompt aggressive monetary tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation regimes is below 0.02.
